basic_info.description: Welcome to a world of elegance and light in this beautiful, light-filled Victorian condo located in the heart of Pacific Heights. The home boasts a dramatic marble-floored entry and brand-new Chevron-patterned hardwood floors throughout. Soaring ceilings create a spacious and airy feel, while the gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream with white marble countertops, a Viking range, and a brand-new dishwasher. Each ensuite bathroom offers exceptional detail, and the double parlor, complete with a gas fireplace, is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A formal dining room and sunny bedroom/library add to the charm. Enjoy outdoor living with a deck that offers captivating city views. The separate guest suite with a full bath ensures privacy for visitors, while the laundry closet with a new washer/dryer adds convenience. Secure parking is available just steps away, making this home as practical as it is beautiful. Live in the heart of the city in this chic, sophisticated retreat - where timeless Victorian elegance meets modern luxury. One car leased garage parking spot has been secured around the corner on Sacramento Street.
